title: Co-Evolving Policy and Rubric via Capability Awareness for Open-Ended Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) offers interpretable, fine-grained supervision for aligning large language models (LLMs) on open-ended generation tasks. However, static rubric criteria may become saturated or remain beyond the policy's exploration, rendering the reward signals insufficiently discriminative. While recent efforts seek to guide sampling exploration or evolve rubrics, they fail to explicitly factor in how rubric difficulty should track the evolving policy's capabilities, resulting in a persistent mismatch between the optimization objective and the policy's current capability frontier. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Co}-Evolving Policy and Rubric via \textbf{C}apability \textbf{A}wareness (\textbf{CoCA}), a closed-loop framework that jointly adapts the rubric and policy through criterion-level diagnosis. translated_title: 通过能力感知实现策略与评分标准的协同进化以用于开放式生成
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的强化学习（RL）为在开放式生成任务上对齐大型语言模型（LLMs）提供了可解释的、细粒度的监督信号。然而，静态的评分标准可能已经饱和，或者超出策略的探索范围，导致奖励信号的区分度不足。尽管近期的研究尝试引导采样探索或进化评分标准，但它们未能显式考虑评分标准难度应如何跟随策略能力的演变而调整，从而造成优化目标与策略当前能力前沿之间的持续不匹配。在本文中，我们提出了通过能力感知实现策略与评分标准协同进化的框架（CoCA），这是一个通过标准级别的诊断来联合调整评分标准与策略的闭环框架。具体而言，CoCA通过对比仅查询与评分标准引导的采样输出，来刻画每个评分标准相对于策略的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CoCA闭环框架，通过能力感知诊断使评分标准难度动态跟踪策略能力前沿，实现策略与评分标准的协同进化，为开放式生成任务提供更具区分度的奖励信号。
en_tdlr: Proposes CoCA, a closed-loop framework that co-evolves policy and rubric through capability-aware diagnosis, aligning rubric difficulty with the policy's current capability frontier to provide more discriminative reward signals for open-ended generation.
